generation.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: one production illustration for Rust Bible Journey, Exodus 8:1–6
Primary request: depict the Egyptian frog sign by editorially connecting the announced domestic invasion in Exodus 8:3 with the fulfillment in Exodus 8:5–6. This is a thematic composition across the passage, not one documentary instant.
Scene/backdrop: an ancient Egyptian mud-brick household/workspace opening onto a sunlit packed-earth courtyard; low clay oven and simple period pottery, with the scene opening toward the outdoor ground.
Subject: a clearly recognizable shallow kneading trough near the left-center, with numerous frogs gathering in and around the trough and many more frogs covering the visible household floor and extending outdoors over the ground. No people.
Style/medium: detailed, gently painterly historical illustration with warm natural sunlight, nuanced earth tones, tactile surfaces, realistic frogs, and cinematic depth; match the warm historical character of the inspected Exodus basket reference.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 1536×1024; important trough and frogs occupy the left/center x=10–60%, y=20–72%; frogs can extend toward the middle; keep the rightmost 32% mostly calm contextual background for a floating scripture window and the bottom 12% free of key subjects.
Lighting/mood: warm, reverent daylight; vivid and consequential without horror.
Materials/textures: worn mud-brick plaster, packed earth, clay oven and pottery, natural dough and trough, softly painterly surface detail.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: the trough detail represents the announcement in Exodus 8:3; the ground covered with frogs represents fulfillment in 8:6. Do not add Aaron inside/by the house; his gesture belongs over the waters in the text. No text, UI, map labels, rings, border, watermark, or logo.
Avoid: gratuitously terrified people, modern objects, gore, dead frogs, lice, Pharaoh, Moses, magicians, fantasy elements, and later plague or deliverance scenes.
generation.edit_prompt: Edit the supplied illustration conservatively. Keep the entire image unchanged except the bottom 12% of the canvas (approximately y=88–100%). Remove frogs and all other visually important subjects from only that bottom strip, continuing the same warm textured packed-earth ground naturally through it. Preserve the kneading trough and its frogs, the wider ground-covered-with-frogs scene, all architecture, lighting, colors, perspective, style, and framing above that strip exactly. Do not add text, UI, border, watermark, or new objects.
